title: AirPods 5, iFixit testinden geçerek Apple'ın tamir edilebilirlik rekorunu kırdı
summary: Apple'ın yeni kablosuz kulaklığı AirPods 5, iFixit'ten 2/10 tamir puanı alarak markanın on yıllık sıfır puan serisini geride bıraktı.
body:
SoundGuys'ın aktardığına göre, kablosuz kulaklık pazarına sunulan AirPods 5 modeli, iFixit tarafından yapılan incelemede 2 üzerinden 10 tamir edilebilirlik puanı aldı. SoundGuys'ın aktardığına göre bu skor, Apple kulaklık serisinin on yıldır sürdürdüğü sıfır puanlık seriyi sonlandırdı.

## Yeni tasarım ve pil değişimi

SoundGuys'ın aktardığına göre, kulaklığın sürücü gövdesindeki dikiş noktalarına kontrollü ısı uygulandığında gövde temiz bir şekilde ayrılabiliyor. Bu tasarım değişikliği, pil değişimini eskiye kıyasla daha kolay hale getiriyor. İç kısımda ise lehim yapma zorunluluğunu ortadan kaldıran pinyerle temas eden modüler bir pil yapısı bulunuyor. Ancak sol ve sağ kulaklık pilleri birbirinin yerine takılamıyor.

## Şarj kutusu ve yedek parça durumu

Şarj kutusu tarafında ise onarımı zorlaştıran yapıştırıcılar ve plastik kaynaklar kullanılmaya devam ediyor; bu yüzden kutuyu açmak kasaya zarar veriyor. SoundGuys'ın aktardığına göre Apple'ın resmi yedek parça, onarım kılavuzu veya servis seçeneği sunmaması da puanın düşük kalmasına neden oldu.

**Neden önemli?** AirPods 5, iFixit değerlendirmesinde elde ettiği 2/10 puanla Apple kulaklık tarihindeki en yüksek tamir edilebilirlik derecesine ulaştı ve küçük pillerin ömrü dolduğunda yaşanan tamamen atılabilir cihaz algısını kısmen değiştirdi.

source_texts.text:
All products featured are independently chosen by us. However, SoundGuys may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links. See our ethics statement.
AirPods 5 break Apple's decade-long repairability curse with a surprising design twist
Sep 30, 2026 — 4:13 AM ET
- The new AirPods 5 earned a 2/10 repair score from iFixit, breaking a ten-year streak of 0/10 scores for Apple’s earbud lineup.
- You can use controlled heat along the earbud driver seam to cleanly separate the housing for an easier-than-before battery swap.
- However, the earbud batteries are not cross-swappable, the charging case is glued shut and gets destroyed during disassembly, and official spare parts remain missing, bringing the score down.
For nearly a decade, Apple’s standard AirPods have earned a notorious 0/10 score on repairability metrics, cementing their reputation as “practically disposable” tech once their tiny lithium-ion batteries degrade. But that narrative is finally showing cracks. As detailed in our AirPods 5 review, Apple brought meaningful updates to its open-ear lineup this year, and now under-the-hood inspections reveal another surprise: the earbuds feature batteries that can actually be extracted and replaced.
According to a report from iFixit, the AirPods 5 earned a 2 out of 10 on the repairability scale. While a 2/10 is dismal by modern consumer electronics standards, it marks the highest score ever awarded to an Apple earbud, breaking a ten-year streak of nothing but straight zeroes.
The breakthrough comes down to how the earbud driver enclosure is sealed. Unlike prior AirPods generations that required cutting through plastic or melting internal wiring to reach the battery, with the AirPods 5, applying gentle, controlled heat (even with a household hair dryer) along the driver seam allows the housing to separate cleanly.
Inside, the earbud uses a modular prong-contact battery reminiscent of the AirPods 3, meaning technicians won’t have to solder directly to the cell to swap it out.
However, the batteries are not interchangeable between sides: the left and right earbuds feature reversed polarities and slightly offset prongs, preventing cross-swapping.
Unfortunately, the case tells the exact opposite story for repairability. Getting inside the charging case remains an exercise in destruction, bound tight with stubborn adhesive and plastic welds where screws could easily have lived. Opening the case inevitably ruins the shell, making a DIY battery swap for the case virtually impossible.
Combined with Apple’s complete lack of official spare parts, repair manuals, or self-service options for the lineup, the AirPods 5 remain a far cry from sustainably repairable earbuds like the Fairbuds. Still, moving away from the destructive glue inside the buds is a step in the right direction, even if Apple still has miles to go, with the AirPods 5 getting a measly (yet its highest-ever) 2/10 score.
- Decent ANC
- Good transparency mode
- Call quality
- IP57 water resistance
- Comfort
- Bass and treble shift depending on volume level
- Short battery life
- $20 upcharge for wireless charging and volume swipes feels unnecessary
